text:
kai: Need a compact battlecard + two landing copy variants for next week's launch. Focus: how Redwood beats cloud-managed endpoints, LLM APIs, and DIY infra on production economics + reliability.

mira: Agree. Keep it opinionated: lead with outcomes (tail latency, predictable unit cost, no-surprises failover).

dante: Small bench snapshot from bench-bot (demo run, 95th pct, 5k tokens):
bench-bot: Redwood-Dedicated: 105ms | CloudManaged: 225ms | API-Provider: 340ms | DIY-Infra: 410ms. Methodology note appended.

zoe: Battlecard bullets (short):
- Unified runtime: same API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Cost controls: batching, quantization suggestions, caching
- Reliability: canaries, routing + automatic fallback

mira: Objection handlers quick draft: Cloud-managed -> "Fast to start; Redwood prevents surprise bills and keeps features live with fallbacks."; LLM APIs -> "Good for protos; Redwood adds rollout controls and caching without replatforming."; DIY -> "You get control with less ops tax via Private."

kai: Landing copy variants: A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and unit economics." B) "One API, production controls, no surprises when models misbehave."

legal-bot: Reminder: no competitor logos, anonymize names, avoid absolute cost claims. Include bench methodology.

mira: Inbound routing: tag 'launch-inference' -> immediate one-pager + bench highlights, 48h demo clip, SDR follow for accounts with >X tokens/mo.

kai: Timeline: draft battlecard + landing copies by EOD; bench slide and 30s demo clip by tomorrow morning. Save to /marketing/webinar/prelaunch/. Ping when live. :rocket:
